resolved_findings.original_issue: Initial setup patch IDs embedded the authored example/family category inside model-visible intention history. Metadata exclusion alone did not remove this shortcut.
resolved_findings.resolution: Current model-visible histories use setup-0/setup-1 only; current 24 exported inputs contain no example_id or family_id label. Attempt 1 and its limitation are preserved.
resolved_findings.verification: Independent read-only comparison of all 24 current SFT inputs/targets and artifact hashes; source validator now checks neutral identity format.

resolved_findings.original_issue: Omission denominator on zero-active-requirement turns needed an explicit rule.
resolved_findings.resolution: Amended protocol excludes undefined turns/families from omission rate, reports their counts and retains unsupported-addition negative analysis.

checks.name: raw-prefix semantics and preservation
checks.details: All 24 raw conversations, pre-state projections, target patches and authored atomic requirements read. Twenty-two accepted labels; two ownership conventions remain ambiguous. All stated untouched requirements are retained.

checks.name: SFT projection and shortcut repair
checks.details: 24 prompt/completion pairs match input/target records; no metadata or expected post-state in user input. Model-visible prior patch IDs contain no authored category.

checks.name: validator scope
checks.details: Real IntentStore replay and preservation checks are appropriate engineering checks. Three invalid corruptions must be rejected atomically; the omitted addition is accepted by runtime and detected only by the authored oracle. This is not semantic quality validation.

checks.name: family split interpretation
checks.details: 12 Chinese/English sibling families and all 24 rows are exposed development-only. No split leakage claim or unseen generalization claim is made. Similar task templates across family names must also be grouped in the future corpus.

checks.name: runtime interface status
checks.details: Two recovery examples use a clearly marked previous_error candidate field; current runtime does not provide it. Owner-resolution and plan-invalidation schema limitations are explicit.

checks.name: causal comparison
checks.details: A/B use identical pinned base, backend, quantization, input, role prompt, decoding and budgets; only tracker adapter toggles. Work/chat and any recovery/handoff repair remain identical. Historical Ollama GGUF runs are not the causal control for new PEFT inference.

checks.name: component versus end-to-end evaluation
checks.details: One-step gold-prior and own-state rollout are separate; final visible-answer omission is separate from tracker recall. Rejections, unresolved runs, safety errors, family clustering and seed variability are disclosed.

checks.name: planned arithmetic versus actual
checks.details: 800/200/400 and 200/50/100 families are future targets, not current records. Current pack has 24 rows, 12 families, 24 SFT pairs, 22 target operations, 6 no-change rows, 40 preserved records and 4 corruption cases. Planned 40 x 2 x 2 = 160 end-to-end trajectories and 160 x 3 x 6 = 2880 calls.

checks.name: inventory independent spot checks
checks.details: Recomputed counts/events/hashes for all 10 enumerated older project case sets, all 11 evidence hashes, all 7 downloaded-source hashes and all 4 enumerated JSONL nonempty-row counts. Rechecked 48/3 evaluation/development assignments, 24/3 stage prefixes, required-need distribution 8x2+12x1+4x0=28, and reused 69/44/25 tracker summary counts. GPU/package availability is treated only as recorded inventory; no training-fit test was rerun.

checks.name: root summary and grouped validation
checks.details: Actual count fields match data/validation.json; root data artifact hashes match current bytes; no measured benefit, trained adapter or completed runtime repair is claimed.

checks.name: primary source notes
checks.details: Official TRL, PEFT, Qwen, SGD and MultiWOZ pages checked. They support the narrow documented interfaces/data descriptions, not training-fit or omission-reduction claims.

nonblocking_open_items: The two ownership examples need a frozen convention and accepted alternatives before training approval; human review is still pending for the whole pack.
Current examples are short and largely explicit. They do not cover long distraction histories, genuinely implicit changes or naturally occurring prior errors sufficiently for an evaluation corpus.
Collect fresh source-family-separated data and semantic labels; exposed examples and old failures remain regression/development material.
Pin exact model/tokenizer/package revisions and verify loss masks, context retention, memory fit, optimizer step, adapter save/reload and actual adapter routing before model experiments.
Power and practical margins remain prospective development-informed decisions. The pilot may be inconclusive; no quality claim follows from these checks.
